country.title: Country
country.remarks: The country where this person resides.

birthdate.title: Date of Birth
birthdate.remarks: The date of this person's birth.

resppartygroupseq.title: Sequence
resppartygroupseq.remarks: A numerical value that indicates to Workflow the assignment sequence for this person.

language.title: Language
language.remarks: This person's language preference for using Maximo.

hiredate.title: Hire Date
hiredate.remarks: The date that this person started working for the company.

pcardnum.title: Card #
pcardnum.remarks: The number on the person's company's credit card.

wfmailelection.title: Workflow E-mail Notification
wfmailelection.remarks: The person's choice of when to receive emailed workflow assignments. A value list field defining the circumstances in which this person will receive workflow related e-mail notification.

vip.title: VIP
vip.remarks: Indicates if this person is a VIP. This field displays a value indicating the level of importance of the VIP.

resppartyseq.title: Sequence
resppartyseq.remarks: A numerical value that indicates to Workflow the assignment sequence for this alternate person.

orgdefault.title: Organization Default
orgdefault.remarks: Indicates that this person is the default person for an organization. Only one person in each organization can be designated as the default in that organization.

wopriority.title: Default WO Priority
wopriority.remarks: The default priority a work order receives when reported by this person.

respparty.title: Person
respparty.remarks: Identifier of the alternate person for a primary member in this person group for Worklfow assignments and notifications.

nextevaldate.title: Next Evaluation
nextevaldate.remarks: The date of this person's next evaluation.

pcardexpdate.title: Expiration Date
pcardexpdate.remarks: The expiration date of the company credit card.

stateprovince.title: State/Province
stateprovince.remarks: The state or province where this person resides; can be the two-character code or full spelling.

lastname.title: Last Name
lastname.remarks: The last name of the person whose record this is.

acceptingwfmail.title: Accepting E-mail
acceptingwfmail.remarks: System-managed flag indicating whether a user is currently accepting emailed workflow assignments

pcardtype.title: Card Type
pcardtype.remarks: The type of credit card used. Enter a value or click Select Value.

supervisor.title: Supervisor
supervisor.remarks: The name of this person's supervisor.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The current status of the person. On inserting a new record, this field defaults to an active status.

firstname.title: First Name
firstname.remarks: The first name of the person whose record this is.

city.title: City
city.remarks: The city where this person resides.

timezone.title: Time Zone
timezone.remarks: The time zone of this person's location.

loctoservreq.title: Default Location to Service Request
loctoservreq.remarks: Indicates if service requests reported by this person will default to the location associated with this person

billtoaddress.title: Bill to Address
billtoaddress.remarks: The billing address of this person. This will be used as the default billing address for purchase transactions entered by the user.

locale.title: Locale
locale.remarks: The date format and the currency format used in the region where this person resides.

title.title: Title
title.remarks: The job title of this person.

pcardverification.title: Verification Value
pcardverification.remarks: The three- or four-digit code at the end of a credit card number; you can find this verification code on the back or front of the card.

delegate.title: Workflow Delegate
delegate.remarks: The delegate for Workflow assignments for this person. If there is a value in this field and if the workflow assignment is received between the Delegate To and Delegate From date, Workflow sends the assignment to the delegate. Enter a value or click Detail Menu to select an option and retrieve a value

delegatefromdate.title: Delegate From
delegatefromdate.remarks: The first date from which this person's delegate takes over the workflow assignments.

sitedefault.title: Site Default
sitedefault.remarks: Indicates that this person is the default person for a site. Only one person in each site can be designated as the default in that site.

droppoint.title: Drop Point
droppoint.remarks: The drop point for making deliveries.

lastevaldate.title: Last Evaluation
lastevaldate.remarks: The date of this person's most recent evaluation.

postalcode.title: ZIP/Postal Code
postalcode.remarks: The zip or postal code of this person.

personid.title: Person
personid.remarks: Identifier of the person's record. This field must be unique.When you save a person record, this field becomes read only.

department.title: Department
department.remarks: The department this person belongs to.

usefororg.title: Use for Organization
usefororg.remarks: The organization that this person is to be used for. If a value is entered in this field, the Use for Site field becomes read-only.

employeetype.title: Employee Type
employeetype.remarks: The type of employee this person is, such as full time or a part time employee.

terminationdate.title: Termination Date
terminationdate.remarks: The date when this person's services are terminated.

groupdefault.title: Group Default
groupdefault.remarks: Indicates that this person is the default person for this group. The first person entered in a group automatically becomes the group default.

locationsite.title: Person's Site
locationsite.remarks: The site to which this person belongs.

transemailelection.title: Notice of E-commerce Exceptions
transemailelection.remarks: The person's choice of when to receive transaction email.

useforsite.title: Use for Site
useforsite.remarks: The site that this person is to be used for. If a value is entered in this field, the Use for Organization field becomes read-only.

shiptoaddress.title: Ship to Address
shiptoaddress.remarks: The shipping address of the person. This will be the default shipping address used for purchase transactions entered by this person.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The date of the last status change.

displayname.title: Name
displayname.remarks: A nick name or a friendly name that this person can be identified with.This field is automatically populated when values are entered in the First Name and/or Last Name fields.

delegatetodate.title: Delegate To
delegatetodate.remarks: The last date till which this person's delegate works on the workflow assignments. The value entered in this field must be either equal to or greater than the value in the Delegate From field.

jobcode.title: Job Code
jobcode.remarks: The job code of this person.

location.title: Person's Location
location.remarks: The place where this person is located.

resppartygroup.title: Person
resppartygroup.remarks: Identifier of the primary member of this person group.
